changes: The flat map is now a real 3D sandstone garden with three terrace heights, visible stairs on disclosed legal passages, original articulated Pip and Thornback models, keys, gates, traps and an exit portal.
Follow, Detail and Overview cameras, a public-data map, optional original audio, captions, reduced motion, high contrast and clean feed are integrated.

Graphics loss reveals a live map, offers a retry and returns to the current public position after restoration. Real results remain visible in map mode; reconnecting is now explicit during terminal states.
Cumulative steps and discovered area reflect the public snapshot. Character feet, route marks, lights and camera targets follow the same stair heights.
The fourth pass gives Pip a coral scarf and bedroll, clearer eyes and directional gaze; Thornback gains a broader bronze face and brighter eyes. These changes await actual render review.
Keys have a thicker silhouette and readable sway; the exit has a mint opening and diamond crown. Quieter decorative trim, grouped planting and shoreline contacts are implemented and await comparison.

Map and Path notes now expand on demand, while the goal and immediate intent stay visible. Friendly captions replace internal object IDs, and the camera label now says Detail. Real browser checks confirm disclosure drawing, Escape/focus behavior and terminal reconnect; current mobile visual comparison remains pending.
nextGaps: Capture the latest build in normal desktop, detail, danger, portrait and landscape views, then give a fresh critic the real output and the same fixed references.
Resolve the remaining reference advantage in landmark composition, material transitions and character expression at native gameplay size; judge the actual key and exit readability.
Review a fresh real recording for gait, turns, stair contact, threat reactions and the timing of arrival and result presentation. Current footage does not establish smooth movement.
Finish the full catalogue regression run and capture the current 3D desktop and mobile presentation for fresh comparison.
Measure actual rendering again when shared-host contention permits, and on a hardware GPU. Enabling a software compositor is not evidence of a frame-rate improvement.
Continue the builder and fresh-critic loop from the largest observed gap; no fixed round count and no benchmark reduction.

reviews.title: Environment comparison · first pass
reviews.summary: The scene still reads as a repetitive flat maze board. Improve architectural hierarchy, focal landmarks, garden scale and material richness. The fixed bar has not been lowered.

reviews.title: Environment comparison · second pass
reviews.summary: The candidate remains a shallow corridor network. Substantial architecture, quieter water, stronger material separation and grouped foliage are the highest-value changes.

reviews.title: Character comparison · first pass
reviews.summary: The 3D explorer has a distinct identity, but the amber/ivory body merges into sandstone at gameplay scale. Broader colour masses, simpler facial detail and clearer pose are needed; warden and motion evidence pending.

reviews.title: Integrated terraced scene · third pass
reviews.summary: Real 3D world and developed explorer/beetle characters are supported by the inspected captures. Captain Toad still wins on landmark composition, connected materials, expression and use of screen space. The comparison was explicitly unblinded because the reference is recognizable; the later fourth-pass changes have not been judged.

verification.name: Current focused source checks
verification.detail: Four catalogue UI contract checks, two character checks, two world checks and eight public-snapshot/motion checks passed on the latest source. Whitespace validation is clean.

verification.name: Current stream host self-test
verification.detail: The fresh self-test confirms served browser assets, bounded source, sanitized snapshots, stable deterministic authority, verified recovery and an observed restart.

verification.name: Latest completed browser suite
verification.detail: Recovery, real-result fallback, audio activation, repeated-run resources, controls and responsive checks passed. The real-3D startup test exceeded its 60-second budget after a roughly 53-second frame wait. Later UI and terminal reconnect changes still need a fresh browser result.

verification.name: Current disclosures and reconnect browser check
verification.detail: The real browser verified a drawn discovered map, expandable Path notes, Escape with focus restoration, and a visible reconnect status that preserves the actual terminal result. The check ran with WebGL unavailable to exercise the live-map recovery path; this is not a fresh 3D performance result.

verification.name: Independent compact-layout repair verification
verification.detail: A fresh reviewer reproduced a clipped Map focus ring and landscape Path notes overlapping captions. The repaired upward popup fits both ordinary and longer production copy at844×390; the real keyboard focus ring was visibly inspected. All eight dated journal images decoded in the same browser.

verification.name: Full catalogue regression
verification.detail: The full local Node suite has not finished. The earlier saved-checkpoint CI had exactly one failure: the Maze frontend revision marker. That fix passes the latest focused suite; Eko Phase 2/3/4 workflows succeeded.

verification.name: Independent visual comparison
verification.detail: Critic 3 inspected the actual third-pass stills and decoded real recording frames. The latest source changes have not been captured and reviewed. Stills and a nominal video frame rate do not establish animation or audio quality.

verification.name: Rendering performance
verification.detail: Independent probes locate the dominant measured stall at native software graphics/compositing, with severe shared CPU contention. New launch flags enable the software compositor, but an actual speed improvement is unverified; the next capture attempt timed out after 45 seconds. Hardware performance is unmeasured.

verification.name: Saved implementation checkpoint
verification.detail: The 3D implementation and the fourth-pass character, world and mobile refinements are on feat/maze-3d-gauntlet for review in draft PR #53. The visual benchmark remains open.

verification.name: Gauntlet continuation
verification.detail: The first scheduled continuation is October 30 at 21:10 UTC, then hourly. No scheduled run has yet been observed. Work continues on the existing branch until an independently verified win or the user stops it, without automatic merge or deployment.
